evidence: Clear separation into distinct layers: domain (models.py), presentation (main.py with FastAPI endpoints), and infrastructure (database.py for persistence)
Database access abstracted via SessionLocal and engine in database.py, used by main.py via dependency injection (get_db)
Models define ORM entities, schemas define data transfer objects (Pydantic), aligning with layered architecture patterns
Low package count (1) and shallow directory depth (2) indicate a monolithic but layered structure
Main.py orchestrates dependencies between layers without tight coupling (fan_out = 2.5)
risks: Tight coupling to FastAPI and SQLAlchemy may reduce testability if not properly abstracted
Service layer missing in observed structure — business logic may reside directly in main.py or models.py, blurring layer boundaries
No clear separation between application core and framework concerns may hinder maintainability as project scales
